title: Google Shakes Up Its Browser Agent Team Amid OpenClaw Craze | WIRED
summary: Google is restructuring its Project Mariner team, with some staff moving on to other projects, but the developed computer use capabilities will be integrated into Google's agent strategy. Meanwhile, the AI industry is shifting focus to command-line-based agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw, which are gaining popularity over web-browsing agents due to their efficiency and capabilities.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a neutral market impact as it discusses Google's internal changes and the industry's shift in focus without indicating a significant negative or positive market event.
